# Third-party sources. They are not in the repository: tools/thirdparty.py fetches each one into
# third_party/<directory> as a git checkout of the listed commit (shallow) and applies CRTOS'
# changes from patches/<directory>.patch. The build runs it on every CMake configure: the
# "base" sources are fetched when they are missing, and any checkout whose commit or patch
# changed here is brought up to date. The other groups are fetched on request
# ("crtos setup --netsurf" or "python tools/thirdparty.py netsurf").
#
# An entry may go on over lines that end with a backslash (joined as they are).
#
# Options after the commit:
#   only=A,B    sparse checkout of these paths alone (files are fetched only for them)
#   skip=A,B    leave out these directories (test files whose names Windows does not allow)
#   group=G     fetched on request (default: base, which every build needs)
#
# directory                  repository                                              commit                                   options

# lwIP 2.2.1 (NXP's fork, MCUXpresso SDK 25.06): drivers/net (lwip.ko)
lwip                         https://github.com/nxp-mcuxpresso/lwip                  fcfb4a7503733cd7f00047fd4ee74298eec5490a only=src,COPYING,README
# TinyUSB 0.21.0: drivers/usb (usb-imxrt.ko, host and device)
tinyusb                      https://github.com/hathach/tinyusb                      dae3f9a366bfcddbf9dcf1b48d7500286a849539 only=src,LICENSE,README.rst
# pdpmake (2026-08-28, public domain): system/commands/make
pdpmake                      https://github.com/rmyorston/pdpmake                    02f03e299ac141817675e2b0d876741ceef136a4

nxp-sdk/core                 https://github.com/nxp-mcuxpresso/mcuxsdk-core          2893c6df8c59f5763476300b584907c4d59ff2e2 only=drivers,COPYING-BSD-3
nxp-sdk/devices-rt           https://github.com/nxp-mcuxpresso/mcux-devices-rt       57a58f6951e2d44f2e7a7f665d9de1a86d40c640 only=RT1050/MIMXRT1052/drivers
nxp-sdk/components           https://github.com/nxp-mcuxpresso/mcux-component        2a884681d3fd3c8d13ea54204208b31513a36c03 only=phy

# newlib and GCC's runtime libraries (the commits of the Arm GNU Toolchain 14.3.Rel1 sources, newlib
# 4.5.0 and GCC 14.3.1): the build compiles lib/xip/libc.a, libm.a, libgcc.a, libstdc++.a and
# libsupc++.a from them - position independent, for programs that run in place
# (toolchain/xiplibs, cmake/xiplibs.cmake). Only the files of those libraries for this CPU.

newlib/libc/ssp,newlib/libc/stdio,newlib/libc/stdlib,newlib/libc/string,newlib/libc/syscalls,newlib/libc/time,\
newlib/libc/machine/arm,newlib/libc/sys/arm,newlib/libm/common,newlib/libm/complex,newlib/libm/fenv,\
newlib/libm/math,newlib/libm/machine/arm
gcc                          https://github.com/gcc-mirror/gcc                       b588d028e85c879452aad962de7d3b71a6b524f0 \
    only=COPYING3,COPYING.RUNTIME,gcc/*.h,gcc/*.def,gcc/config/*.h,gcc/config/arm/*.h,include,\
libgcc/*.c,libgcc/*.h,libgcc/*.inc,libgcc/config/arm,libiberty/cp-demangle.c,libiberty/cp-demangle.h,\
libstdc++-v3/include,libstdc++-v3/libsupc++,libstdc++-v3/src,libstdc++-v3/config/abi/compatibility.h,\
